items.title: David Torkanowsky interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, September 26, 2019
items.q: Dr. John could play Bill Evans’ tunes. He was a musician of the highest order.

ctx.x: Now I’ll say this though as an aside. Dr. John could play Bill Evans’ tunes. He was a musician of the highest order. When you hear Dr. John play “Waltz for Debbie” it’s like transformative. But obviously he wasn’t known for that, but he was a good musician. Sorry you were going to —
Well what would you tell an aspiring singer to have ready when they go — they’re going to sit in in a club or they’re trying to get their name out there. What should they bring to the table besides —
